# Runtime notices

These original upstream notices cover native runtime components whose notices are not always included in Python wheel metadata or the installed interpreter's Tcl directory.

| File | Original source |
| --- | --- |
| `Tcl-license.terms` | <https://github.com/tcltk/tcl/blob/core-8-6-13/license.terms> |
| `TkDnD-license.terms` | <https://github.com/petasis/tkdnd/blob/tkdnd-release-test-v2.9.4/license.terms> |

The build copies both notices verbatim into the portable package, alongside the installed runtime and Python-package notices.
